note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden flags follow the 28-hidden split those lists report. Every guide is written in my own words for this entry and names its sources; no guide text is copied from any source.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned; there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat the roadmap in this guide as the plan: story first, then character quests, then the long collect-and-grind clean-up, with 100% completion last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks in normal play, and nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. This is story only: keep playing through the chapter's missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only, like the other chapter trophies; it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only; play the chapter's missions through and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only; it pops when the chapter closes, on the way to the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to try a different approach to the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Story only; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Story only, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Story only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Story only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Story only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only; it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which appears after the story; work done earlier still counts toward it. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: the checklist asks for 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals and 70 of 80 challenges, not everything. It is the last trophy for most players and the hardest of the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses and air time all count toward the running total, which you can watch in the stats menu. Ramps around Vice City rooftops, the Keys bridges and Mount Kalaga ridges are the usual farming spots, and the total builds up naturally across the 100% grind.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. A single attempt at each is enough; a win is not required. Open the activities list in the pause menu and work down it one by one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own range and weapon set; gold needs speed plus accuracy, so learn the target pattern first with a slower run, then push for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course; winning once per location is enough, and you can retry a course as often as you like.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, boat and air races all count, as long as each is a different event, so tick them off across the map rather than replaying one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge when it is offered and out-fish him on weight; heavier tackle and a calm spot help.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game: play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game you find.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Andy's strand. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances; keep returning to Andy's marker until his last mission appears, then finish it.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Kenton's strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear and finish the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Billy's strand. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission and complete it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strands appear as markers in free roam; start each one when it appears, because at least one of them is time-sensitive: Yago's street-racing strand in Chapter 3 has a timed Race Against Yago that can expire if you ignore it.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Randy's strand. Follow Randy's missions as they appear until the last one, then complete it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Follow Tyrone's missions as they appear until the last one, then complete it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of them, but this trophy needs every one. This is the one possibly missable trophy: PowerPyx and GTABase both warn that Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house is offered in Chapter 1, on a morning after the mission Down to Earth, and is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Do it the moment it appears, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one special animal; follow the hunting prompts to track it, then take the shot when it is lined up.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are found across Leonida and in shops; a set is complete when every card in it is collected, and three finished sets pop the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations: any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Open WAiNK near a point of interest and scan it; the app counts each new location once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges. Challenges come in 8 categories of 10, 80 in total, and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this pops on the way there. Pick the easiest categories first and let the rest build up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape. Build heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays live: keep the getaways short and do not let the heat drop between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you meet them; the 100% checklist later needs 200 of 277, so keep scanning everything you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a busy firefight, trigger Combat Focus with a group clustered together, and chain all five before it runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Grab a plane on the runway and take off without following the normal departure routine.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Raise your wanted level until Rhino tanks are sent after you, then take one on: destroy it or steal it. The hotter the heat, the sooner the tanks roll in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected. Go in quiet, with no alarms tripped and no witness spotting you, take the goods and get out clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault needs its own plan and a clean getaway; five successful vault jobs pop the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape. Ram or breach a truck on the road, grab the cash inside and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the regions: Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get clear; nine gangs means nine hits.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch: only the description is known. Try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view; the trophy should pop when the scene triggers. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The description points at a vehicle showroom: smash your way out of one in classic style, driving a car through the showroom glass and out the other side. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: play a game of bowling there and finish it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger yet at launch; the description hints at a partnership moment with mass appeal. Play the duo content with your partner and watch for a big shared moment. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports 500 such actions are tracked, so small decisions across the game add up and the trophy pops after enough of them. This count is single-sourced, so treat it as reported rather than certain.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch; the description only says second time's the charm. It is reported to trigger on a second attempt at something after a first failure, so retry failed events rather than reloading a save. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch; the description only asks what the hell just happened. It is a one-off strange encounter somewhere in Leonida, so keep exploring odd spots and it should pop when you find it. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet at launch. The name and description point at bowling someone over with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Both sources above list it as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts a little at a time until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and cars all count; the total builds up naturally over a full playthrough, and big purchases near the end close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market as they appear; the last purchase pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles out in the world, then register each one in the app until you reach ten.
